## Behavior
As a visitor, I can browse visual examples and find an effect by category, name, or animation framework.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given catalog metadata, when browsing, then searchable/filterable cards lead to stable detail URLs with representative previews. Categories reflect the inventory. Only implemented examples are presented as usable; planned coverage is clearly distinguished. The site remains usable on mobile and with keyboard navigation.

## Ownership
videoml-org, stdlib, player

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
